decision_conditions: The proposed rear extension, by reason of its excessive size, scale, bulk, design and depth represents an oversized, incongruous and visually disproportionate form of development that would fail to relate appropriately to the architectural integrity of the host dwelling and the adjoining row of terraced dwellings consequently the extension would be detrimental to the character and appearance of the area, contrary to Policies D3 and D4 of the London Plan (2021, Policies DMHD 1, DMHD 11 and DMHD 12 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part Two - Development Management Policies (2020) and Paragraph 135 of the NPPF (2024).

The proposed rear extension, by reason of its excessive size, scale, bulk, depth and position would be detrimental to the amenities of the neighbouring occupiers at Numbers 53 and 53B Bellclose Road, by virtue of the overbearing scale of the development, overshadowing, loss of light and loss of outlook and would be contrary to Policies D3 and D6 of the London Plan (2021) and Policies DMHD 1 and DMHB 11 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part Two - Development Management Policies (2020).

In dealing with the application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive way. We have made available detailed advice in the form of our statutory policies from the  Local Plan Part 1, Local Plan Part 2, Supplementary Planning Documents, Planning Briefs and other informal written guidance, as well as offering a full pre-application advice service.

In order to ensure that the applicant has been given every opportunity to submit an application which is likely to be considered favourably. In addition further guidance was offered to the applicant by the case officer during the processing of the application to identify the amendments to address those elements of the scheme considered unacceptable which the applicant chose not to implement.
description: Single-storey rear extension without foundation with glazing
